CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate set) and a separate origin/representation entry for the same referent/time are both explicitly present, satisfying C, O and D bindings.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The text lists identified content items (color-labeled coordinate sets) with explicit referents.

D.rationale: Content coordinate entries are presented alongside separate origin/representation metadata, distinguishing identification from status/access.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

O.rationale: The report states how candidate peaks are presented and provides origin/representation metadata for specific referents, indicating organization/access.
